nodes.label: Nino README and dated research history
14 November frozen Goal100 evaluation: retain B0
nodes.rationale: 24 slots produced 23 QC-valid outcomes and 3,648 decisions. B0 and 10k passed 5/6; 15k passed 4/6; 20k had 4 pass, 1 fail and 1 unknown. The training job remains failed because its historical 54 ms gap also appears in PI diagnostics. Retain B0 and prioritize goal-stop/odometry and startup wheel freshness.

nodes.label: 14 November episode retention and deletion receipts
nodes.rationale: Reclaimed 3.37 GiB by deleting 36 raw files from 12 evaluated successful episodes and losslessly compressing 206 historical streams. Checkpoints/replay at 10k, 15k and 20k, training trace, failures and current qualification remain. The evaluation retains 753 manifest-matching files plus receipts for 36 deletions, rather than a full raw archive.

nodes.label: 12 November Goal100 research20k training with failed raw QC
nodes.rationale: Completed 20,000 transitions, 10,000 critic and 5,000 actor updates; 113/126 training episodes succeeded and one segment was censored. A 54 ms drive gap in episode 57 failed raw QC. The no-evaluation status recorded on 12 November is historical and is superseded by the 14 November evaluation entry.

nodes.label: 10 November Goal100 Gazebo integration and TD3 smoke
nodes.rationale: Seven launches and 970 ticks included 384 training transitions, 368 critic and 184 actor updates. Deterministic development evaluation reached the goal and stopped for two seconds; B0 succeeded 2/3. This entry establishes integration, without demonstrated learned benefit.

nodes.label: 10 November common103_v2 seed11 reached 50k and failed evaluation
Unknown traversable obstacle and path-following research direction
nodes.rationale: The selected objective replaces known-route preview vibration reduction. Controller inputs are IMU, encoders, history and reference; ground truth, contact and obstacle metadata are reserved for scoring. Vibration and slip are secondary outcomes. Later dated entries record software, Gazebo, training and evaluation progress.

nodes.label: Supported simulation scope: factory and flat
nodes.rationale: Rough/rocky course commands and assets were removed on 8 November. Historical terrain descriptions elsewhere in the README do not expand current supported scope.

nodes.label: Historical October reactive-governor experiments
nodes.rationale: The October studies include arrival/stop checks, contact timing, sampling sensitivity, repeatability and rejected brake-delay candidates. Local improvements coexist with variable whole-route slip and vibration; the recorded work does not promote a governor or establish repeatable sensor-only benefit.

nodes.label: Historical PPO curriculum and terrain-preview workflows
nodes.rationale: These sections describe older PPO speed/torque or speed/yaw interfaces, curriculum stages, downward-LiDAR preview and training commands. Dated entries identify later residual TD3 contracts; the historical instructions are not evidence that their observation, action or reward interfaces are current.

nodes.label: Compare task success before tracking and comfort
nodes.rationale: A stopped or failed robot can have low RMSE. Reports separate all episodes from successful episodes and require compatible task configuration, seeds, counts and perturbation mode; incomplete evaluations cannot be compared as full runs.

nodes.label: Geometric path versus timed trajectory scoring
nodes.rationale: Timed scoring requires a shared clock origin, strictly increasing timestamps and gap coverage without alignment or extrapolation. A geometric path has no desired timing. Wheel odometry transformed by localization is not independent physical ground truth.
